record.title: Cementitious Repair Mortars - Industrial and Building Concrete Repair
record.description:
Specifies composition, fresh-state properties, hardened performance, and application-related requirements for pre-bagged cementitious repair mortars used for patching and restoration of concrete substrates.

Applies to non-structural and defined repair applications where the repair material is mixed and placed according to the manufacturer instructions; excludes resin-based repair systems.

Key requirements: Specified compressive strength shall be achieved at the declared test age.; Fresh mortar shall meet workable consistency and water-demand limits.; Bond performance to the defined concrete substrate shall meet the acceptance threshold.

Testing: Compressive strength test on prepared mortar specimens.; Bond strength or pull-off test on the defined substrate configuration.
record.certification_applicability: Certification generally voluntary unless a project specification, procurement condition, or applicable order requires conformity to this standard.
